subject: 13 Videos from CVAI: Igor Babuschkin, Ryan Daniels, Guillermo Rauch & More
notes: Recap of 13 onstage conversations at the Cerebral Valley AI Summit. No funding rounds, acquisitions, funds or price changes reported.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang's forced resignation from Nvidia, referred to throughout the summit recap
stories.quote: Last week, top founders and investors gathered for the Cerebral Valley AI Summit during one of the most turbulent weeks the industry has seen, marked by global cyberattacks and Jensen Huang’s forced resignation.

facts.text: Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora would not say whether he would take Huang's place at Nvidia; he expects short-term instability but no serious harm to the company.
facts.quote: Arora wouldn’t say whether he’d take Huang’s spot at Nvidia, as some tech leaders have suggested. He expects Huang’s resignation to cause short-term instability but doesn’t think it will seriously hurt the company.

facts.text: General Catalyst CEO Hemant Taneja said the shakeup raises concerns about continuity but could open the door for more chip startups.
facts.quote: General Catalyst CEO Hemant Taneja said the Nvidia shakeup raises “huge concerns” about continuity in AI leadership, but could also open the door for more chip startups.

facts.text: Databricks CEO Ali Ghodsi said Huang's exit removes a financial backstop for the AI industry.
facts.quote: Databricks CEO Ali Ghodsi said Huang’s exit removes a financial backstop for the AI industry, since Huang was quick to support companies whenever investors hesitated.

facts.text: Etched employs more than 100 former Nvidia workers, its co-founder said.
facts.quote: Robert Wachen, co-founder and president of AI chip and rack maker Etched, said Huang’s resignation hit hard at a company that employs more than 100 former Nvidia workers.

stories.headline: Databricks CEO says 2026 is a bad year to go public but Databricks will not stay private forever
stories.quote: He still thinks 2026 is a bad year to go public, but said Databricks won’t stay private forever.

facts.text: Bessemer's Byron Deeter discussed why 2027 could bring a wave of AI IPOs.
facts.quote: Afterward, Deeter joined Eric Newcomer to discuss why Anthropic ranks ahead of OpenAI, how Databricks and Stripe fit into the AI economy, and why 2027 could bring a wave of AI IPOs.

stories.headline: Fireworks CEO describes recently disclosed security incident as an attack to steal compute and tokens for resale
stories.quote: Qiao discussed the security incident Fireworks disclosed recently, describing it as an attack aimed at stealing compute and tokens to resell. Fireworks worked with Palo Alto Networks on forensics and used detection tools from CrowdStrike and Wiz.

stories.headline: River AI, new company of xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, has a first product for post-training and running models on own hardware
stories.quote: His new company, River AI, wants to give businesses, and eventually individuals, models they can own and improve themselves. Its first product lets companies post-train and run models on their own hardware.
stories.description: Models businesses can own, post-train and run on their own hardware

stories.headline: Bessemer AI 100 list companies are worth a combined $3.6 trillion
stories.quote: The companies on the list are worth a combined $3.6 trillion, 36 times the value of the first Cloud 100 in 2016.

facts.text: The AI 100 was made in partnership with Newcomer and presented at the Cerebral Valley AI Summit.
facts.quote: Bessemer’s Byron Deeter and Talia Goldberg gave a rundown on the AI 100 , made in partnership with Newcomer, onstage at the Cerebral Valley AI Summit.
